name: Bulk Copy Fields
description: Provides a bulk action that copies values from one field to another compatible field across selected content entities, via a multi-step confirmation form and Batch API.
project_description: Bulk Copy Fields adds a core Action that copies the value of one field into another compatible field across the content entities selected on a Core Bulk Operations listing (for example /admin/content). On install and whenever a new entity type appears, the module auto-creates one configured action per entity type (id 'bulk_copy_fields_on_<entity_type>', label 'Bulk Copy <Label> Fields'). Choosing the action stores the selected entities in the private tempstore and redirects to a four-step confirmation form (/admin/bulk_copy_fields): pick languages, pick source field(s), map each source field to a same-type destination field, confirm. A Batch process then copies each source field's value into the destination field on every selected entity and saves it (creating a new revision for nodes). Field types must match (with date/created/changed grouped as datetime, entity_reference_revisions mappable to entity_reference, and string_long mappable to text_with_summary); entity-reference target types and bundles are validated and incompatible referenced items are dropped with a warning. There is no undo. The module is explicitly experimental and, per its own maintainer notes, is designed for Core Actions only, not the contrib Views Bulk Operations module.
